description: The weight targets use on a day: the mean of the weight entries dated in the 7 calendar days ending on that day (day - 6 to day, both inclusive), rounded half-up to one decimal; with none in that window, the most recent earlier entry as logged; with none at all, null. Entries after the day are ignored. Dates are local "YYYY-MM-DD" strings. Ports compute the mean first, then round; the corpus avoids exact .x5 means, which binary floating point cannot hold.

cases.why: Three weigh-ins in the week ending on the day are averaged, (70.0 + 71.0 + 70.5) / 3 = 70.5, smoothing water swings.
An entry eight days before is outside the 7-day window and does not drag the mean: only 70 kg counts.
Nobody weighs every week: with no entry in the window, the latest earlier weight (71 kg on 15 October) still applies.
A past day keeps the weight known then: an entry logged two days later must not change it.
With an empty log the caller falls back to the questionnaire weight, so this returns null rather than 0.
The window start crosses a month end: 2 March minus 6 days is 24 February, inclusive, so 80 kg counts and 23 February does not.
The mean (70 + 70.1 + 70.15) / 3 = 70.083 is rounded to one decimal, 70.1, so both apps show the same figure.
